label: Manuscript C begun
summary: A dated note in Paris Manuscript C records that Leonardo began the book and resumed work on the horse on this day.

claims.statement: Paris Manuscript C carries a note dated 23 April 1490 recording the start of the book and the resumption of the horse.

sources.cite: Facsimile Finder, Unveiling Leonardo: the secrets within the 12 notebooks at the Institut de France.

check_in: Marinoni edition of the Institut de France manuscripts (Giunti, 1986 to 1990), introduction to the volume
